evidence_class: Static: source and accepted-authority inspection only; reviewer performed no build, test, candidate replay, Python execution, physical run, or target run
scope: BVLS-03 whole-work accounting integration only: refinement ledger, partial failures, ordered KKT, upward enclosure, controller result/refusal propagation; accepted C2 arithmetic was not re-reviewed

requirements: K(m)=R(m)+39816+1827+129 and G(m)=3*K(m)+213+2*m bound each eligible face
capacity for K(m)/G(m) is established before refinement entry
each actual operation and guard category is incremented before execution, including refusal work
cap denial performs no partial refinement and retains the owning work-cap refusal

reviewed_sources.moving_source_note: Concurrent C3 authoring changed test-observation/API code while this audit ran. The closing probe rechecked every accounting anchor listed in the findings and observed identical before/after close hashes; this review does not approve the concurrent C3 additions.

findings.finding: The ordered KKT vector and upward Cbar/tau enclosure execute outside RefinementWorkLedger. assess_optimality retains only a local u16 operation observation, and solve_subproblem discards observations from release transitions. Actual eligible-face scalar and guard totals therefore omit both the 1827 KKT operations and every executed enclosure operation/guard, including partial failures and intermediate release faces.
findings.minimal_required_correction: Record whether the current FaceSolution actually applied BVLS-03, then only for that face thread the existing state ledger through checked_optimality and upward-enclosure primitives. Increment immediately before each executed arithmetic/upward operation and each operand/result guard, including error exits. Let the state ledger span release and final faces; do not post-charge the 1827/39816 maxima or reconstruct work from the final observation.

findings.finding: Guard accounting at the refinement seam is incomplete. Both factor-output factor_counters are discarded; both coordinate updates discard the helper counters and substitute only one manual guard; refinement_active_admit discards its counters; p0/p1/p2 equality, finite, box and radius predicates are not charged as E(m); and the p1 rejected-box status is not evaluated at this runtime seam. Consequently successful and failing paths under-report G(m).
findings.minimal_required_correction: Thread or return exact counters from these helpers and absorb them on success and error. For coordinate updates, use the helper's exact arithmetic/guard delta instead of also retaining the manual scalar/guard charge. Charge the E(m) predicates at the actual ascending-order sites, including p1 rejected-box observation. Snapshot the actual pre-admission p0 scalar/guard delta and reserve K/G minus that delta; the fixed required_guards-43 subtraction at lines 4074-4075 becomes invalid once the required p0 seam guards are recorded.

findings.finding: The Jacobi no-convergence branch constructs a fresh subproblem_refusal, resetting all earlier refinement work to zero after prior faces may have completed or refused refinement.
findings.minimal_required_correction: Return state_refusal with SvdNoConvergence. jacobi_factor already advances state.completed_sweeps through the failed sweep, so preserve that state value and all monotonic refinement counters.

findings.finding: Whole-controller totals are derived only from successful proposal_trace entries. A later transition error exits through ? and exposes only the current subproblem refusal, losing previously successful proposal work from the whole-solve record. The physical run observation also omits all four refinement counters, and an error prevents controller_run from being installed.
findings.minimal_required_correction: Accumulate the four counters monotonically at the existing controller transition boundary and surface prior-success plus current-refusal totals on typed failure without replacing the owning error/refusal kind. Copy the same totals into the physical run observation on success and retain a test-visible typed failure accounting record on error. Do not synthesize a successful proposal trace for a refusal.

findings.finding: factor_application_operations is updated only after lambda_step returns Ok. lambda_step advances the total ledger before each operation, so an error preserves total partial work but loses the corresponding factor category work.
findings.minimal_required_correction: Capture the lambda_step Result, update factor_application_operations from the post-call minus pre-call total on both Ok and Err, then propagate the existing typed refinement refusal.

findings.finding: Several lambda_step guard increments precede combined predicates over multiple source/result values rather than one increment per actual guarded operand/result event. The current ledger therefore cannot demonstrate the authority's per-guard monotonic accounting even after discarded local counters are wired.
findings.minimal_required_correction: At the same arithmetic sites, increment once for each actual source or result guard that is evaluated. Preserve the frozen arithmetic grouping and existing refusal precedence.

residual_risk_and_missing_tests: No implementation fix or green evidence existed for this audit; every finding requires same-reviewer static verification on a frozen body before execution is credited.

Controls must distinguish reserved maximum capacity from executed work: crossing before KKT must not charge KKT/enclosure, zero-skipped enclosure operations must not be charged, and partial failures must retain only work actually attempted through the failure.

Required focused evidence includes successful eligible face, release then later face, factor failure after partial work, KKT and enclosure early failures, Jacobi no-convergence after prior refinement, one-less-cap denial with zero post-admission work, and controller failure after at least one successful proposal.
This artifact does not approve C3/C4 APIs, physical execution, target execution, or package closure.
